title: AttributeError in user.lookup when signing in
body:
## Environment

Lattice 3.3.9, Debian 12, server eu-central-1.

## Steps

To reproduce:
* Start by signing in.
* Install this release over the previous one without changing settings.
* Wait for the failure and read the log.

## Expected

Expected signing in to finish without errors.

## Actual

It fails on every attempt since the upgrade; the previous release never did this. It began right
after upgrading to this release; nothing else changed.

## Frequency

Happens every time.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:50 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:124 in on_login
lattice/auth/flow.py:56 in start
lattice/auth/user.py:214 in lookup
AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'roles'
